item.tib: mdel thung gi za kha dbal 'beb
item.coloph: dbal mo las kyi thig le ma'u (bu) sde skor 'di rnams zab za 'grub myur bas/ hris pa gyer med dang / khod spungs dran pa gnyis kyis gces par dgongs nas/ cha gcig gsang brag rgya bo la sbas so/ cha gcig lcags 'phrang mda' phugs la sbas so/ cha gcig yar lha sham po la sbas so/ 'di rnams sbed (sbas) dus su/ me chu rlung gsum kyi (gyis) mi khyer ba'i smon lam dang bkra shis gsol lo/ sman dang g+hi 'ang gur gum gi byug pa byas/ phyi dus dar ba'i dpe rjes la smon lam btab b+ho/ phyi bar (rabs) las can gcig gis spel rgyas spyod par 'gyur ro/ dam med zog po bon gi (gyi) tshong pa la ag tham/ yum sras lnga'i (lngas) thub par bsrungs/ ces gsungs te sbas snyo/ gter rgya/ gab rgya/ gtad rgya/ bslig tsi bslob (slob) dpon la skor gcig rdzogs so//
